run_train_detector: run the train_detector script to train a Faster R-CNN model on the Penn-Fudan dataset with SGD
run_get_backbone: run get_backbone to build a neural network backbone from a genotype or DeepNets1M architecture
run_get_model_detection: run get_model_detection to assemble a Faster R-CNN detection model with a custom backbone
review_main: review the main function that orchestrates dataset loading, model training, and evaluation for object detection
refactor_get_backbone: refactor get_backbone to support additional genotype types or backbone architectures for detection tasks
